performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; GBP dark 4 days compounds a paid-only channel.

findings.text: ROAS fell 70.18% week-over-week while spend rose 28.1%; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) show 8 purchases/$159.23 revenue vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7) 4 purchases/$520.42 — revenue per dollar collapsing.
Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due 2026-08-14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails all overdue as of 2026-08-31 — 5 milestones uncleared.
GBP actions read 0 for 4 consecutive days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 26/day prior — profile appears dark or suppressed, cutting organic-to-site pipeline at 535 web clicks/28d.

Top campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' consumed $839.56 of $1,485.91 (56%) in 28 days; 3-day purchase count dropped to 1 from a prior 3-day high of 5 — fatigue or audience saturation probable given known retargeting burnout history.
IG reach rose 9.62% week-over-week to 20,218 (28d) while paid ROAS crashed — organic lift is not converting; paid and organic are decoupled, suggesting a landing-page or checkout friction issue.

suggestions.text: Cut 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' daily budget by 20% (~$11/day) and hold pending 3-day ROAS recovery signal.
suggestions.monday_update: Reduce 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' daily budget by 20% (approx. $11/day based on ~$57/day current run rate). This campaign is 56% of 28-day spend ($839.56) with 3-day revenue collapsing to $159.23 vs $520.42 the prior 3 days and ROAS down 70.18% week-over-week. Success check: ROAS stabilises above 3.0x within 3 days (by 2026-09-14); if not, escalate to creative refresh. Do not cut further until new creative is ready to absorb the saved budget.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP profile — 4 consecutive zero-action days risks losing 535 monthly web clicks from organic.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have read zero for 4 straight days (Sep 7–10) against a prior average of 26 actions/day and 535 web clicks in the 28-day window. Check for a suspended listing, a pending verification request, or a category/info edit that triggered a review hold. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥15/day within 3 days of the fix (by 2026-09-14).

suggestions.text: Watch Sep 7–10 purchase drop (1 purchase, $500 revenue) for 3 more days before any landing-page conclusion.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach is up 9.62% but paid ROAS collapsed simultaneously, suggesting a possible landing-page or checkout friction issue rather than purely an ads problem. Only 1 purchase recorded Sep 7–10 against $159.23 revenue. Do not act on this until Sep 14 — if the pattern holds after the budget trim (S1), escalate to a funnel audit. This is hypothesis-grade only.
